tools.name: fdic_bank_search
tools.description: Search FDIC-insured US banks by name, state, city, ZIP code, or FDIC CERT number. Returns active insurance status, CERT number, headquarters, charter class, total assets, total deposits, equity capital, net income, ROA, ROE, office count, and website.

tools.name: fdic_bank_financials
tools.description: Retrieve quarterly FDIC Call Report financial health metrics for a bank by CERT number (or bank name + optional state): total assets, total and domestic deposits, insured vs uninsured deposits and uninsured share %, equity capital, Tier 1 capital, CET1 ratio, Tier 1 risk-based capital ratio, YTD net

tools.name: fdic_failed_banks
tools.description: Search the official FDIC Failed Bank List from 1934 to the present by bank name, state, or year range, or omit filters to list the most recent US bank failures. Returns failure date, location, assets and deposits at failure, estimated Deposit Insurance Fund (DIF) cost, resolution type, and CERT numb

tools.name: fdic_bank_branches
tools.description: Find physical branch locations of FDIC-insured banks by CERT number, bank name, ZIP code, city, or state. Returns branch name, street address, county, main-office indicator, service type code, and latitude/longitude.
